headline: Frontier Sectors Show Renewed Base Turmoil
war_summary: The latest returns shift the spotlight toward several unsettled sectors. Stonecradle has sharpened markedly, posting five base events in two hours and seven in six, with two Warden holdings set among seven Colonial. Stlican Shelf is similarly active, recording five events in the latest two hours and thirteen across the day; its ledger stands at two Warden and seven Colonial bases. Weathered Expanse reports five events in two hours and fourteen in six, leaving five Colonial holdings and four neutral—an especially fluid record. Nevish Line has gone quiet in the immediate window, but still shows eight events in six hours and 56 in 24, with six Warden and two Colonial bases. Callahan’s Passage remains a heavy-action sector, registering two events in two hours and 17 over the day, though all ten bases currently stand Warden. Mooring County has seen no event in two hours, yet its casualty figures remain high and three events are logged across the day. Elsewhere, most fronts show little or no recent base movement; the war’s victory status remains undecided.
